title: TokenTrimmer agent-run receipt
description: Structural contract for the offline-verifiable top-level agent-run receipt returned by the shareable receipt GET endpoint. Use tt verify-receipt with a trusted out-of-band key to verify the signature.
$comment: This schema validates receipt structure only. It does not validate an Ed25519 signature, issuer identity, savings methodology, provider usage, or invoice reconciliation. Unknown additive fields are allowed for forward-compatible response envelopes.

run_id.description: Top-level agent-run UUID; also the receipt primary key. There is intentionally no workflow_id.

org_id.description: Organization UUID, signed as canonical payload field 2.

status.description: Nonempty terminal agent-run status. The cloud mint currently has its own terminal-status allowlist; this offline structural contract accepts any nonempty pipe-free status so a valid receipt remains verifiable if that issuer-side allowlist evolves. A pipe is forbidden because it is the canonical payload separator.

cost_micros.description: Recorded catalog-priced run cost in integer micro-USD; signed directly.

baseline_micros.description: Recorded catalog-priced baseline estimate in integer micro-USD; signed directly.

saved_micros.description: Recorded catalog-priced net savings estimate in integer micro-USD; signed directly.

cost_usd.description: Convenience display field only; not part of the signature.

baseline_usd.description: Convenience display field only; not part of the signature.

saved_usd.description: Convenience display field only; not part of the signature.

signature_hex.description: Hex-encoded 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload.

verifying_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key. Trust must be established out of band.

canonical_version.description: The canonical payload version; v1 is the currently supported format.

signed_at.description: Receipt mint timestamp. It is frozen by the ledger but not part of the canonical payload.
